source.document: CCPA Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Greenwashing, 2024

qualifier_terms: compostable in industrial facilities within 180 days

explain.en: Biodegradability and compostability claims must specify the required disposal environment, timeframe, and accredited test standard.

remediation.en: Specify testing standard (e.g. IS/ISO 17088), degradation timeframe, and CPCB registration number.

tests.notes: Missing condition, timeframe, and CPCB standard
